changes.change: Added a 22-bay upper facade glazing band and slender dark mullions on the candidate north-side edge of an R5 coarse wing envelope.
changes.basis: The geotagged 2016 exterior image shows an upper horizontal glazing strip above red-brick facade; FRP project images support the broad brick/glass material vocabulary.
changes.confidence: Low-to-moderate for the facade feature family; low for exact location, width, height, and rhythm.
changes.uncertainty: The geotag locates the camera northwest of the GIS footprint, but the photo has no bearing, camera calibration, facade control points, or dimensioned elevation. Exact facade assignment remains uncertain; the mesh is a qualitative facade cue, not a photo-registered window schedule.

changes.change: Applied one restrained red ACM material treatment to the high LiDAR roof-zone's upward faces and to the existing roof ACM material used by the two older roof slabs.
changes.basis: FRP project documentation identifies Mayflower Red ACM in the roof/truss expression; the R5 NDHM defines only a broad, registered height zone.
changes.confidence: Moderate for red ACM as a finish family; low for exact cladding boundary, topography, cantilever shape, and panel layout.
changes.uncertainty: The LiDAR surface is a coarse roof-height envelope and does not recover the cantilevered roof geometry. R6 does not alter the R5 wing heights or footprints. The old roof slab geometry remains a simplified pre-existing representation.

changes.change: Produced an isolated two-level bridge section render for legibility; no bridge or circulation geometry was changed.
changes.basis: FRP explicitly describes exposed concrete bridges with glass rails at two atrium levels and three concrete stairs; its interior photographs show the general form.
changes.confidence: Moderate for the two bridge levels as building features; low for modeled exact span, termini, and coordinates.
changes.uncertainty: Available imagery is not registered to the asset. Existing modeled bridge spans and the one schematic stair remain unverified for path continuity, landing location, accessibility, and complete floor-to-floor circulation. The R6 section isolates the two bridge objects and is not a complete atrium cutaway.

changes.change: Adjusted render exposure, lighting, and framing; the section render temporarily substitutes an opaque tinted glass proxy to make the existing safety-rail positions visible.
changes.uncertainty: Temporary camera, lights, visibility changes, and render-only material override were not saved to the .blend asset.

unchanged: Root transform, manifest placement marker, and R5 GIS/LiDAR wing masks/heights.
Existing shell and original geometry aside from the building-local Mayflower Red ACM material color update.
No new floor plans, roof slope, penthouse placement, room layouts, stair runs, or GIS registration adjustments were inferred.
